title: Antibody-based regimens targeting PD-1/PD-L1 and VEGF/VEGFR in advanced or metastatic NSCLC: a meta-analysis of RCTs.
caption: Forest plot of EGFR-related subgroup analyses for OS.meta-analysis.
context: Forest plot of EGFR-related subgroup analyses for OS.meta-analysis. The relevant content is presented in Figure 5 . For OS, the funnel plot appeared largely symmetrical, and Begg’s test did not detect significant publication bias (p=0.072), as shown in Supplementary Figure 5 .
